answer: A mechanism that actually bites: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because violet only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, river is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any juniper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
